name: bench_twobody
description: Free-floating base body + revolute-jointed arm, no contact geometry. Used to verify conservation of linear momentum (system CG trajectory) and mechanical energy for the articulated RNEA/Jacobian formulation.

joints.name: test_pivot
joints.note: T1 rotation = Rx(-90 deg) so the joint's local Z axis (revolute axis) points along the parent's world Y axis => hinge is horizontal, arm swings in the X-Z (vertical) plane.
